_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Trackmania
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The dedicated server for Trackmania. Runs on the LAN without an account; with a dedicated server login it's listed online for everyone.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Trackmania. Downloads Nadeo's current dedicated server (which publishes no
# checksums: the archive is checked to be whole before anything is
# replaced). UserData (settings, maps, match settings) is never touched once
# it exists; the server's own files are replaced.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Nadeo's file host only answers plain HTTP.
url=http://files.v04.maniaplanet.com/server/TrackmaniaServer_Latest.zip
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
[ "$(uname -m)" = x86_64 ] || fail "The Trackmania server only runs on x86 (amd64) nodes."

etag=$(curl -fsSI --retry 3 "$url" | tr -d '\r' | awk 'tolower($1) == "etag:" { print $2 }') ||
    fail "Nadeo's download server can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
if [ -n "$etag" ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-tm 2>/dev/null)" = "$etag" ] && [ -x TrackmaniaServer ]; then
    echo "The current Trackmania server is already installed."
else
    build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
    rm -rf "$build"
    mkdir -p "$build/x"
    trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
    echo "Downloading the Trackmania server (about 250 MB)"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/tm.zip" "$url"
    unzip -tq "$build/tm.zip" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "The download isn't a whole zip file. Reinstall to try again."
    unzip -q "$build/tm.zip" -d "$build/x"
    [ -f "$build/x/TrackmaniaServer" ] || fail "The download has no TrackmaniaServer in it."
    rm -rf Packs RemoteControlExamples
    mv "$build/x/Packs" Packs
    [ ! -d "$build/x/RemoteControlExamples" ] || mv "$build/x/RemoteControlExamples" RemoteControlExamples
    mkdir -p UserData
    cp -an "$build/x/UserData/." UserData/
    rm -rf "$build/x/UserData"
    chmod +x "$build/x/TrackmaniaServer"
    cp -af "$build/x/." .
    echo "$etag" > .raptor-tm
fi

if [ ! -f UserData/Config/dedicated_cfg.txt ]; then
    cp UserData/Config/dedicated_cfg.default.txt UserData/Config/dedicated_cfg.txt
fi
echo "Installed the current Trackmania server."

variables.name: Server login
variables.description: The login of a dedicated server account, made on the Trackmania website. Empty runs a LAN server.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Comment
variables.description: A description shown with the server.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: A password players need to join. Empty lets anyone join.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The most players connected at once.

variables.name: Match settings
variables.description: The match settings file, relative to UserData/Maps, that sets the mode and the maps.
